reply:
That changes it. `defer` queues the Close call to run when the function returns, not at loop iteration end. All N file handles stay open simultaneously until the function exits. Once open handles hit the OS limit (typically ~1024), the next `os.Open()` fails.

Concrete cost: `os.Open()` returns an error, which you're ignoring with `_`. Silent failure — files don't get processed, or the program crashes when it tries to use those handles.

Fix: call `fh.Close()` directly in the loop instead of deferring, or wrap the open-read-close in a separate function and defer within that.
